I'm not capable of directly accessing or monitoring your Mac or any other device. I can only provide general guidance and information.

To view the applications currently running on your Mac, you can use the built-in Activity Monitor or the Command + Tab shortcut to see a list of open applications. Alternatively, you can use the `ps` command in the Terminal app to view a list of running processes.

If you need help with using any of these methods, I can provide more detailed instructions. However, I won't be able to access or view your Mac's current state directly.
